text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

Australia, Sept 23 - COAL - Queensland, Abbot Point - berth vacant, 8 vessels due by 14/9, no delays. Hay Point - two vessels loading, 4 waiting, 17 due by 20/10, 1-2 days delay. Dalrymple Bay - two vessels loading, 2 waiting, 11 due by 14/10, 1-2 days delay. Gladstone - R.G. Tanna 2 vessels loading, 27 due by 27/10, 1-2 days delay. Brisbane - one vessel due 27/10, no delays.

NSW - Newcastle - dykes 4+5 - 2 vessels loading, 6 waiting, 16 due by 7/10, 5-7 days delay. Kooragang 2 vessels loading, 5 waiting, 9 due by 7/10, 4-5 days delay. Port Kembla - berth vacant, 19 vessels due by 5/10, 1-2 Days delay expected.

IRON ORE, Western Australia - Dampier - Parker Point 1 vessel loading, 1 due by 24/9. East Intercourse Island 1 vessel loading, 1 due by 26/9. Dampier line-up 12 vessels due by 6/10 of which 7 for Parker Point, 5 for East Intercourse Is. Port Walcott - one vessel berthed, 8 due by 2/10. Port Hedland - BHP iron ore, Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) A Berth - 1 vessel loading 5 due by 1/10. B Berth 1 loading, 2 anchored, 5 due by 1/10. 1 Other vessel due by 14/10 BHP iron ore, Goldsworthy (Finucane Is) 4 vessels due by 28/9, 3 other vessels due by 7/10

GRAIN - Queensland, Sept 25 - Mackay - no vessels due. There is a small amount of sorghum remaining in the area, but no further shipments expected for the season. Gladstone - three vessels due by 25/10 of which 2 to load wheat, 1 sorghum. Brisbane - one vessel due 27/9 to load wheat.

New South Wales - Newcastle - one vessel loading wheat, 3 due by 12/10, all to load wheat. Sydney - no further grain loading expected. Port Kembla - one vessel waiting to load wheat, 2 due by November, both to load wheat. Victoria - Geelong - nine vessels due by 20/10 of which 5 to load wheat, 2 barley, 1 oats, 1 peas. Portland - five vessels due by 14/10 of which 3 to load wheat, 1 peas, 1 barley.

South Australia - Port Pirie - three vessels due by 8/10 of which 2 to load wheat, 1 barley. Port Adelaide - one vessel loading canola, 6 due by 10/10 of which 3 to load wheat, 2 barley, 1 malt. Thevenard, Wallaroo, Port Giles - no vessels due. Port Lincoln - one vessel loading wheat/barley. Ardrossan - one vessel due 27/9 to load barley.

Western Australia - Geraldton - one vessel loading wheat, 3 due by 5/10 of which 2 to load wheat, 1 lupins. Kwinana - one vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load barley, 6 due by 10/10 of which 5 to load wheat, 1 barley. Loading terminal has now come to an agreement with unions, evening shifts, in addition to the day shifts, available from Monday To friday. Albany - six vessels due by 16/10, all to load wheat. Esperance - two vessels due by 6/10, 1 to load barley, 1 wheat.
